title: ARACHNE: SEARCH BASED REPAIR OF DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus was on repairing general misclassifications and gender fairness in Deep Neural Networks.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The research focuses on a technical method for repairing errors and biases (specifically gender bias) in deep neural networks.
